# NEW 2026-11-19 v6.6 R2 phases 1-4, Crimea and the northern shore. Generated by gen_crimea.py; edit the generator, not this file.

# BYZ scope, monthly. Called by the main-line scheduler (gen_mainline_lock.py, LINES, id 27); this line writes no
# monthly hook of its own. Order (design 3.3): start, void checks, close; then the books, the world steps, and at most
# one event in a calm, free month.
oe_crm_monthly = {
    if = {
        limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_crm_off } }
        if = { limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_crm_live } } set_global_variable = oe_crm_live }
        if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_crm_on } } set_variable = oe_crm_on }
        set_variable = { name = oe_crm_m value = oe_ml_month_now }
        oe_crm_void_check = yes
        if = {
            limit = { OR = { current_date >= 1476.4.1 AND = { has_global_variable = oe_crm_g_void has_global_variable = oe_crm_f_void } } }
            oe_crm_war_off = yes
            set_variable = oe_crm_off
            debug_log = "oe_crm: the line is closed"
        }
        else = {
            oe_crm_books = yes
            oe_crm_world = yes
            oe_crm_events = yes
        }
    }
}

# BYZ scope. A half becomes void when its preconditions fail (design 3.2). The chronicle rows look at what had
# happened by then (oe_crm_chr_*), so history that already took place is not turned into "void".
oe_crm_void_check = {
    if = {
        limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_crm_g_void } oe_crm_g_pre = no }
        set_global_variable = oe_crm_g_void
        debug_log = "oe_crm: the Gazarian half is void"
    }
    if = {
        limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_crm_f_void } oe_crm_f_pre = no }
        set_global_variable = oe_crm_f_void
        debug_log = "oe_crm: the Theodoran half is void"
    }
}

# BYZ scope, monthly. The months .1 has waited since its world step; the end of Caffa's war (k3: the peace of 1387;
# k6: a year after it).
oe_crm_books = {
    if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_crm_wait_1 NOT = { has_variable = oe_crm_st_1 } } change_variable = { name = oe_crm_wait_1 add = 1 } }
    if = {
        limit = { has_global_variable = oe_crm_cw_until var:oe_crm_m >= global_var:oe_crm_cw_until }
        oe_crm_war_off = yes
    }
    # phase 4: Gazaria's tribute to the sultan (k8) ends once k9 is on record, whether Caffa fell or not
    if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_crm_ws_k9 } oe_crm_tribute_off = yes }
}

# Any scope. Caffa's war is over: the name the grain road (D1 phase 3) and the trading posts (D3 phase 3) read goes;
# the Solkhat war ends in a peace that restores the old lines (no land changes hands).
oe_crm_war_off = {
    if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_crm_caffa_war } remove_global_variable = oe_crm_caffa_war }
    if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_crm_cw_until } remove_global_variable = oe_crm_cw_until }
    if = { limit = { oe_crm_solkhat_on = yes } set_global_variable = { name = oe_crm_solkhat value = 2 } }
}

# BYZ scope, monthly. World steps (design 3.5): only while every country involved is AI, no pop-up, no lock, each once.
# Phases 1-2: k1-k6; phase 3: k7 the plague ships; phase 4: k8 the Bank and the sultan's fleet, k9 / k9m Gedik Ahmed's
# fleet (Caffa, then Mangup).
oe_crm_world = {
    # k1 Soldaia changes hands (months 343-354, 25% a month, sure in the last)
    if = {
        limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_crm_ws_k1 } var:oe_crm_m >= 343 }
        if = { limit = { var:oe_crm_m <= 354 oe_crm_k1_ok = yes oe_crm_k1_when = yes } random = { chance = oe_crm_ch_k1 oe_crm_k1_run = yes } }
        if = {
            limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_crm_ws_k1 } var:oe_crm_m >= 354 }
            if = { limit = { oe_crm_k1_skip = yes } set_global_variable = { name = oe_crm_ws_k1 value = 3 } set_global_variable = { name = oe_crm_soldaia value = 3 } }
            else = { set_global_variable = { name = oe_crm_ws_k1 value = 2 } set_global_variable = { name = oe_crm_soldaia value = 2 } }
            debug_log = "oe_crm world step k1 missed (ws [GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_crm_rd_ws')|0])"

# BYZ scope, monthly. Events: lapse, then at most one in a calm month while the lock is free (design 3.3).
oe_crm_events = {
    if = { limit = { oe_crm_lapse_13 = yes } set_variable = { name = oe_crm_st_13 value = 2 } }
    if = { limit = { oe_crm_lapse_2 = yes } set_variable = { name = oe_crm_st_2 value = 2 } }
    if = { limit = { oe_crm_lapse_1 = yes } set_variable = { name = oe_crm_st_1 value = 2 } }
    if = { limit = { oe_crm_lapse_12 = yes } set_variable = { name = oe_crm_st_12 value = 2 } }
    if = { limit = { oe_crm_lapse_11 = yes } set_variable = { name = oe_crm_st_11 value = 2 } }
    if = {
        limit = { oe_crm_calm = yes oe_ml_free = yes }
        set_variable = { name = oe_crm_pick value = 0 }
        if = { limit = { var:oe_crm_pick = 0 oe_crm_ok_13 = yes } random = { chance = oe_crm_ch_13 set_variable = { name = oe_crm_pick value = 13 } } }
        if = { limit = { var:oe_crm_pick = 0 oe_crm_ok_2 = yes } random = { chance = oe_crm_ch_2 set_variable = { name = oe_crm_pick value = 2 } } }
        if = { limit = { var:oe_crm_pick = 0 oe_crm_ok_1 = yes } random = { chance = oe_crm_ch_1 set_variable = { name = oe_crm_pick value = 1 } } }
        if = { limit = { var:oe_crm_pick = 0 oe_crm_ok_12 = yes } random = { chance = oe_crm_ch_12 set_variable = { name = oe_crm_pick value = 12 } } }
        if = { limit = { var:oe_crm_pick = 0 oe_crm_ok_11 = yes } random = { chance = oe_crm_ch_11 set_variable = { name = oe_crm_pick value = 11 } } }
        if = { limit = { var:oe_crm_pick = 13 } set_variable = { name = oe_crm_st_13 value = 1 } set_variable = { name = oe_crm_last value = 13 } trigger_event_non_silently = oe_crm.13 }
        if = { limit = { var:oe_crm_pick = 2 } set_variable = { name = oe_crm_st_2 value = 1 } set_variable = { name = oe_crm_last value = 2 } trigger_event_non_silently = oe_crm.2 }
        if = { limit = { var:oe_crm_pick = 1 } set_variable = { name = oe_crm_st_1 value = 1 } set_variable = { name = oe_crm_last value = 1 } trigger_event_non_silently = oe_crm.1 }
        if = { limit = { var:oe_crm_pick = 12 } set_variable = { name = oe_crm_st_12 value = 1 } set_variable = { name = oe_crm_last value = 12 } trigger_event_non_silently = oe_crm.12 }
        if = { limit = { var:oe_crm_pick = 11 } set_variable = { name = oe_crm_st_11 value = 1 } set_variable = { name = oe_crm_last value = 11 } trigger_event_non_silently = oe_crm.11 }
        remove_variable = oe_crm_pick
    }
}

# BYZ scope. A world step runs: its effect, its record (global oe_crm_ws_<s> = 1, oe_crm_at_<s> = the month), the wait of
# the event that follows it. k1 and k2 are recorded as done only when the land really went over (else 4).
oe_crm_k1_run = {
    oe_crm_k1_do = yes
    if = {
        limit = { location:soldaia = { oe_crm_gen_holds = yes } }
        set_global_variable = { name = oe_crm_ws_k1 value = 1 }
        set_global_variable = { name = oe_crm_at_k1 value = var:oe_crm_m }
        set_global_variable = { name = oe_crm_soldaia value = 1 } set_variable = { name = oe_crm_wait_1 value = 0 }
        debug_log = "oe_crm world step k1 done in month [GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.GetVariable('oe_crm_m').GetValue|0] (ws [GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_crm_rd_ws')|0], facts [GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_crm_rd_facts')|0])"
    }
    else = {
        set_global_variable = { name = oe_crm_ws_k1 value = 4 }
        set_global_variable = { name = oe_crm_soldaia value = 2 }
        debug_log = "oe_crm world step k1: the engine did not move the land (ws [GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_crm_rd_ws')|0])"
    }
}

    }
}

# BYZ scope. k1 Soldaia changes hands (1365): the Genoese of Caffa take soldaia from its steppe owner. Nothing moves
# when the Genoese side holds it already.
oe_crm_k1_do = {
    location:kaffa = { owner = { save_scope_as = oe_crm_gz } }
    if = {
        limit = { location:soldaia = { oe_crm_steppe_owner = yes } }
        location:soldaia = { owner = { save_scope_as = oe_crm_st } }
        location:soldaia = { change_location_owner = scope:oe_crm_gz }
        scope:oe_crm_st = { add_opinion = { modifier = oe_crm_bw_soldaia target = scope:oe_crm_gz } }
    }
}
# BYZ scope. k2 the coast of Gothia (the treaties of 28 November 1380 and 23 February 1381): lusta goes to the owner of
# Caffa by treaty, and the two think better of each other. Nothing moves when the Genoese side holds it already.
oe_crm_k2_do = {
    location:kaffa = { owner = { save_scope_as = oe_crm_gz } }
    if = {
        limit = { location:lusta = { oe_crm_steppe_owner = yes } }
        location:lusta = { owner = { save_scope_as = oe_crm_st } }
        # Soldaia comes with the coast when k1 never happened and the same steppe owner still holds it.
        if = {
            limit = { oe_crm_soldaia_taken = no location:soldaia = { owner ?= scope:oe_crm_st } }
            location:soldaia = { change_location_owner = scope:oe_crm_gz }
            if = { limit = { location:soldaia = { oe_crm_gen_holds = yes } } set_global_variable = { name = oe_crm_soldaia value = 4 } }
        }
        location:lusta = { change_location_owner = scope:oe_crm_gz }
        scope:oe_crm_st = { add_opinion = { modifier = oe_crm_bw_treaty target = scope:oe_crm_gz } }
        scope:oe_crm_gz = { add_opinion = { modifier = oe_crm_bw_treaty target = scope:oe_crm_st } }
    }
}
# BYZ scope. k3 the Solkhat war (the mid-1380s to the peace of 12 August 1387): no real war and no land; Caffa
# strengthens its walls. The war ends in the first month from 608 (oe_crm_books); a test button that runs it outside
# its window gives it 24 months.
oe_crm_k3_do = {
    location:kaffa = {
        owner = { save_scope_as = oe_crm_gz }
        add_location_modifier = { modifier = oe_crm_caffa_walls years = 30 mode = replace }
    }
    location:solkhat = { owner = { save_scope_as = oe_crm_st } }
    scope:oe_crm_st = { add_opinion = { modifier = oe_crm_bw_solkhat target = scope:oe_crm_gz } }
    scope:oe_crm_gz = { add_opinion = { modifier = oe_crm_bw_solkhat target = scope:oe_crm_st } }
    set_global_variable = { name = oe_crm_caffa_war value = 1 }
    set_global_variable = { name = oe_crm_solkhat value = 1 }
    if = {
        limit = { var:oe_crm_m >= 582 var:oe_crm_m < 608 }
        set_global_variable = { name = oe_crm_cw_until value = 608 }
    }
    else = { set_global_variable = { name = oe_crm_cw_until value = { value = var:oe_crm_m add = 24 } } }
}
# BYZ scope. k4 the ruin of Theodoro (about 1395; who did it is not said): the city looted, the principality poorer
# and humbled.
oe_crm_k4_do = {
    location:theodoro = { add_location_modifier = { modifier = looted years = 5 mode = replace } }
    c:FEO = {
        add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_crm_feo_ruin years = 10 mode = replace }
        add_prestige = prestige_mild_penalty
    }
    set_global_variable = { name = oe_crm_feo_ruined value = 1 }
}
# BYZ scope. k5 Alexios rebuilds (the 1420s): the city and the harbour of Kalamita; the marriage of the lord's
# daughter into the house of Trebizond is only good opinion between the two (C1's line ended long before).
oe_crm_k5_do = {
    c:FEO = {
        if = { limit = { has_country_modifier = oe_crm_feo_ruin } remove_country_modifier = oe_crm_feo_ruin }
        add_prestige = prestige_mild_bonus
    }
    location:theodoro = { add_location_modifier = { modifier = oe_crm_kalamita years = -1 mode = replace } }
    if = {
        limit = { country_exists = c:TRE c:TRE = { is_ai = yes } }
        c:FEO = { add_opinion = { modifier = oe_crm_bw_trebizond target = c:TRE } }
        c:TRE = { add_opinion = { modifier = oe_crm_bw_trebizond target = c:FEO } }
    }
    set_global_variable = { name = oe_crm_alexios value = 1 }
}
# BYZ scope. k6 the Cembalo war (summer 1434): the roll decides; no war. Lost (history, global oe_crm_cembalo 1): the
# Genoese retake Cembalo and sack Kalamita, then their army is routed near Solkhat. Held (2): Theodoro keeps the town
# and takes back the coast. Either way the khan besieges Caffa for a ransom: oe_crm_caffa_war for 12 months.
# BYZ variable oe_crm_k6_force (1 or 2; the test buttons) fixes the result.
oe_crm_k6_do = {
    location:kaffa = { owner = { save_scope_as = oe_crm_gz } }
    set_global_variable = { name = oe_crm_cembalo value = 1 }
    if = { limit = { var:oe_crm_k6_force ?= 2 } set_global_variable = { name = oe_crm_cembalo value = 2 } }
    else_if = {
        limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_crm_k6_force } }
        random = { chance = oe_crm_cembalo_chance set_global_variable = { name = oe_crm_cembalo value = 2 } }
    }
    if = {
        limit = { has_global_variable = oe_crm_cembalo global_var:oe_crm_cembalo = 1 }
        location:theodoro = { add_location_modifier = { modifier = looted years = 2 mode = replace } }
        c:FEO = { add_prestige = prestige_weak_penalty }
        scope:oe_crm_gz = { add_prestige = prestige_mild_penalty }
    }
    else = {
        location:lusta = { if = { limit = { oe_crm_gen_holds = yes } change_location_owner = c:FEO } }
        c:FEO = { add_prestige = prestige_mild_bonus }
        scope:oe_crm_gz = { add_prestige = prestige_severe_penalty }
    }
    c:FEO = { add_opinion = { modifier = oe_crm_bw_cembalo target = scope:oe_crm_gz } }
    scope:oe_crm_gz = { add_opinion = { modifier = oe_crm_bw_cembalo target = c:FEO } }
    set_global_variable = { name = oe_crm_caffa_war value = 1 }
    set_global_variable = { name = oe_crm_cw_until value = { value = var:oe_crm_m add = 12 } }
}
# BYZ scope. k7 the plague ships (1347): vanilla's own variable on Genoa. Vanilla's flavor_gen.44 (Genoa, 1340-1400,
# 10% a month while the Black Death is active) then seeds the plague in Genoa, Constantinople and Messina and removes the
# variable. This line never starts or spreads the plague itself.
oe_crm_k7_do = {
    c:GEN = { set_variable = { name = genoese_plague_bringer value = yes } }
}
# BYZ scope. k8 the Bank and the sultan's fleet (1453/54): Genoa hands Gazaria to the Bank of Saint George; the Ottoman
# fleet cannot take Caffa and the khan's horsemen come to its aid, but Caffa pays tribute from then on. Only when
# Gazaria itself owns Caffa (once Genoa has annexed it there is no colony to hand over). No subject relation.
oe_crm_k8_do = {
    location:kaffa = { owner = { save_scope_as = oe_crm_gz } }
    if = {
        limit = { scope:oe_crm_gz = { tag = GAZ } }
        scope:oe_crm_gz = {
            add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_crm_bank_rule years = -1 mode = replace }
            add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_crm_ott_tribute years = 22 mode = replace }
        }
    }
    c:TUR = { add_prestige = prestige_weak_bonus }
}
# BYZ scope. k9 Gedik Ahmed's fleet, Caffa (June 1475): what an AI of the Genoese side holds of soldaia, vosporo, lusta, tana, kaffa goes
# to the Ottomans, Caffa (the capital) last. The tribute of k8 ends.
oe_crm_k9_do = {
    location:soldaia = { if = { limit = { oe_crm_gen_holds = yes } change_location_owner = c:TUR } }
    location:vosporo = { if = { limit = { oe_crm_gen_holds = yes } change_location_owner = c:TUR } }
    location:lusta = { if = { limit = { oe_crm_gen_holds = yes } change_location_owner = c:TUR } }
    location:tana = { if = { limit = { oe_crm_gen_holds = yes } change_location_owner = c:TUR } }
    location:kaffa = { if = { limit = { oe_crm_gen_holds = yes } change_location_owner = c:TUR } }
    oe_crm_tribute_off = yes
}
# BYZ scope. k9 Gedik Ahmed's army before Mangup (December 1475): Theodoro falls. When all its land lies in the Crimea
# it is annexed (the form seen to work in game, r19 and r20 engine probe 6); else only its Crimean locations go.
oe_crm_k9m_do = {
    if = {
        limit = { c:FEO = { NOT = { any_owned_location = { NOT = { area = area:crimea_area } } } } }
        c:TUR = { annex_country = { country = c:FEO reason = Diplomatic transfer = yes } }
    }
    else = {
        area:crimea_area = {
            every_location_in_area = {
                limit = { has_owner = yes owner ?= c:FEO }
                change_location_owner = c:TUR
            }
        }
    }
}
# Any scope. Gazaria's tribute to the sultan ends (k9 on record).
oe_crm_tribute_off = {
    if = {
        limit = { country_exists = c:GAZ c:GAZ = { has_country_modifier = oe_crm_ott_tribute } }
        c:GAZ = { remove_country_modifier = oe_crm_ott_tribute }
    }
}

# BYZ scope. Pay $months$ months of trade and tax income.
oe_crm_pay = { add_gold = { value = monthly_income_trade_and_tax multiply = -$months$ } }
# BYZ scope. Opinions of the empire ($m$ = the opinion): Theodoro; the owner of Caffa while it is of the Genoese side;
# Genoa, unless Genoa itself owns Caffa (it then got the opinion as the owner).
oe_crm_feo_opinion = {
    if = { limit = { country_exists = c:FEO } c:FEO = { add_opinion = { modifier = $m$ target = c:BYZ } } }
}
oe_crm_gz_opinion = {
    location:kaffa = {
        if = {
            limit = { has_owner = yes owner = { oe_crm_gen_side = yes } }
            owner = { add_opinion = { modifier = $m$ target = c:BYZ } }
        }
    }
}
oe_crm_gen_opinion = {
    if = {
        limit = { country_exists = c:GEN NOT = { location:kaffa = { owner ?= c:GEN } } }
        c:GEN = { add_opinion = { modifier = $m$ target = c:BYZ } }
    }
}
# BYZ scope. The bond with Gothia rises by $n$, 0-5 (later lines read it: N4, the strong routes).
oe_crm_tie_up = {
    if = {
        limit = { has_variable = oe_crm_feo_tie }
        change_variable = { name = oe_crm_feo_tie add = $n$ }
        clamp_variable = { name = oe_crm_feo_tie min = 0 max = 5 }
    }
    else = { set_variable = { name = oe_crm_feo_tie value = $n$ } }
}

# BYZ scope. One debug_log line with the readouts (test page, observer logs).
oe_crm_log = { debug_log = "oe_crm m=[GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_crm_rd_m')|0] ws=[GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_crm_rd_ws')|0] facts=[GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_crm_rd_facts')|0] st=[GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_crm_rd_st1')|0]/[GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_crm_rd_st2')|0]/[GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_crm_rd_st11')|0]/[GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_crm_rd_st12')|0]/[GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_crm_rd_st13')|0] side=[GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_crm_rd_side')|0] suit=[GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_crm_rd_suit')|0] lament=[GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_crm_rd_lament')|0] kin=[GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_crm_rd_kin')|0] lom=[GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_crm_rd_lom')|0] tie=[GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_crm_rd_tie')|0] cembalo%=[GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_crm_cembalo_chance')|0] void=[GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_crm_rd_void')|0] last=[GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_crm_rd_last')|0] ws2=[GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_crm_rd_ws2')|0] facts2=[GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_crm_rd_facts2')|0]" }

# BYZ scope. Run a world step now: the date is ignored, the AI and the preconditions are still checked.
oe_crm_test_k1 = {
    set_variable = { name = oe_crm_m value = oe_ml_month_now }
    if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_crm_ws_k1 } debug_log = "oe_crm test: k1 is already recorded (ws [GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_crm_rd_ws')|0]); reset first" }
    else_if = { limit = { oe_crm_k1_ok = yes } oe_crm_k1_run = yes }
    else = { debug_log = "oe_crm test: k1 cannot run now (a player involved, a precondition or a war)" }
}

# BYZ scope. Show an event now: its world step runs first if it can (date ignored); when it cannot, its result is
# recorded for the text only and nothing in the world changes. The window, the church, the wars and the lock are left out.
oe_crm_test_1 = {
    set_variable = { name = oe_crm_m value = oe_ml_month_now }
    if = { limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_crm_ws_k1 } oe_crm_k1_ok = yes } oe_crm_k1_run = yes }
    if = {
        limit = { oe_crm_soldaia_taken = no }
        set_global_variable = { name = oe_crm_soldaia value = 1 }
        debug_log = "oe_crm test: k1 could not run as a world step; its result was recorded for the text only"
    }
    if = { limit = { oe_crm_ev_1 = yes } set_variable = { name = oe_crm_st_1 value = 1 } set_variable = { name = oe_crm_last value = 1 } trigger_event_non_silently = oe_crm.1 }
    else = { debug_log = "oe_crm test: .1 cannot be shown (Theodoro, Genoa or the owner of Caffa is gone)" }
}
oe_crm_test_2 = {
    set_variable = { name = oe_crm_m value = oe_ml_month_now }
    if = { limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_crm_ws_k2 } oe_crm_k2_ok = yes } oe_crm_k2_run = yes }
    if = {
        limit = { oe_crm_ran_k2 = no }
        set_global_variable = { name = oe_crm_ws_k2 value = 1 } set_global_variable = { name = oe_crm_coast value = 1 }
        debug_log = "oe_crm test: k2 could not run as a world step; its result was recorded for the text only"
    }
    if = { limit = { oe_crm_ev_2 = yes } set_variable = { name = oe_crm_st_2 value = 1 } set_variable = { name = oe_crm_last value = 2 } trigger_event_non_silently = oe_crm.2 }
    else = { debug_log = "oe_crm test: .2 cannot be shown (Theodoro, Genoa or the owner of Caffa is gone)" }
}

# BYZ scope. Switch the name D1 phase 3 and D3 phase 3 read: on for 12 months of the line's count, or off.
oe_crm_test_war = {
    set_variable = { name = oe_crm_m value = oe_ml_month_now }
    if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_crm_caffa_war } oe_crm_war_off = yes }
    else = {
        set_global_variable = { name = oe_crm_caffa_war value = 1 }
        set_global_variable = { name = oe_crm_cw_until value = { value = var:oe_crm_m add = 12 } }
    }
}
# Any scope. Switch the name colonisation phase 3 reads (oe_crm_fall, "Gazaria has fallen"): on with 1, or off. Only the
# name: nothing in the world changes.
oe_crm_test_fall = {
    if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_crm_fall } remove_global_variable = oe_crm_fall }
    else = { set_global_variable = { name = oe_crm_fall value = 1 } }
}
# Any scope. Design item 5: does vanilla's food access relation do what the modifier oe_crm_gothia_grain stands for?
# Theodoro gives Byzantium food access; look at the relation, its direction and the food of the capital in game.
oe_crm_test_food = {
    if = {
        limit = { country_exists = c:FEO country_exists = c:BYZ }
        create_relation = { type = relation_type:food_access first = c:FEO second = c:BYZ }
    }
    else = { debug_log = "oe_crm test: Theodoro is gone" }
}
